conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Summary of the contents of Dr. Moric's notebook: This notebook contains discoveries from the Crusader's Tomb in Węgrów, a 13th-century basement belonging to the Sacred Shield Society. The common goal of the Sacred Shield Society is to hunt dangerous heretics and guard dangerous evil artifacts. This society was founded by Regent Yolanda of Constantinople and Pope Honorius III in 1218. The underground vault was created by Sir Miho of Dubrovnik, a founding member of the society, with the assistance of several Frankish knights (David, Martinus, Renaud, and Eloise). It was used to store evil items and documents seized by Count Baldwin, Yolanda's brother, during the Fourth Crusade. The most dangerous item in the collection is the Serpent's Claw, also known as the Flaying Blade, an evil knife with Satanic power once wielded by Sayf al-Din, a mortal enemy of Christendom. The first record of the Flaying Blade appears in the military records of troops serving Emperor Constantine in the early 4th century AD, see the Records of Titus Corvus. A dangerous religion that worships flayed human skin and abominable creations considers the Flaying Blade sacred. The society believed that crushing could destroy the Serpent's Claw, but their era lacked such power. The content of the last page is: Prepare to talk with Golan, check the Bratovich Cement Plant. Write to player8... Yamina, if you see this, please ensure everything here is sent to Dr. R. Jordanov, Director of Ancient History, National Archaeological Museum, Sofia, Bulgaria.
